inventories.description: Derived path inventories, one sorted repository path per line, stored beside this contract so concurrent changes extend different lines instead of rewriting a shared aggregate. Read them through tools/card_profile_closure.mjs, which sorts and deduplicates, never positionally.

measurement.description: Path counts, byte totals and the revision the profile was derived at are reporting figures that move whenever any tracked file does. They are derived on demand rather than committed, because committing them makes every change rewrite the same lines.

observed.description: Repository paths recorded by tools/card_profile_sentinel.cjs while each supported gate class ran on a full checkout.

static.description: Repository paths named by an import specifier or a path-shaped string literal in worker/, site/, tools/ and test/ sources.
static.worker_to_site_data_targets_note: The site/data paths a Worker source reaches across the package boundary for. This is the CI-08 risk the profile has to hold; the list itself is the worker_to_site_data_targets inventory.

declared.description: Structural trees a card-work checkout holds regardless of gate reads, minus the byte-heavy excluded trees.

deferred_hydration_set.description: Tracked paths a scanned source references but no supported gate class was observed to read. They stay out of the working tree; a supported gate that reaches for one fails closed through tools/card_profile_sentinel.cjs, and tools/provision_card_profile.sh hydrate materialises it.

full_checkout_only.title: Site standards, i18n and copy lint family
full_checkout_only.reason: The standards suite walks the whole tracked site tree, including the excluded site/data, site/agencies and site/media payloads.

full_checkout_only.title: Site and contract unit suites
full_checkout_only.reason: test/*.test.mjs and test/contract/*.test.mjs read tracked builder inputs across site/data, data/ and entity_resolution/.

full_checkout_only.title: Generated-document and source-contract checks
full_checkout_only.reason: The owning builders read and rewrite tracked projections across the excluded trees.

full_checkout_only.title: RCP-03 evidence placement receipt
full_checkout_only.reason: Measured to read 3,535 tracked paths totalling 615.4 MiB, which is close to the whole tracked tree.

full_checkout_only.title: Reading-level ratchet gate
full_checkout_only.reason: Walks the served site documents, which the profile does not materialise.

full_checkout_only.title: Accessibility, browser and performance families
full_checkout_only.reason: They serve the built site, which requires the generated Pages build over the full tracked payload.

full_checkout_only.title: Generated site build
full_checkout_only.reason: The Cloudflare Pages build reads the complete tracked site payload.

full_checkout_only.title: Release-surface and deployment checks
full_checkout_only.reason: Release evidence is derived from the full tracked tree and from generated build output.

full_checkout_only.title: Guards that resolve a merge base against main
full_checkout_only.reason: A depth-limited profile cannot supply a merge base. The default card profile keeps complete commit history for exactly this reason; the opt-in --depth variant must be unshallowed first.

full_checkout_only.title: Repository control-plane cutover receipt
full_checkout_only.reason: It asserts that every retained evidence projection resolves on disk, and it does so with an existence check rather than a content read. CI-09's recorder deliberately records only content reads, because recording metadata probes grew the closure to the whole tracked tree, so this gate's true closure was never observed. Its retained set reaches into site/data, warehouse/ and docs/screenshots, which the profile defers, and it was measured failing in a reduced checkout at this revision.

missing_path_behaviour: A tracked path the profile does not materialise is marked skip-worktree in the index. tools/card_profile_sentinel.cjs turns a missing-file error on such a path into CardProfileMissingPath and records it, so a profile gap fails closed instead of passing by omission.

functional_corpus.description: The tracked read-model corpus tools/prepare_functional_site.sh must hold before it can materialise the static-first document routes the functional browser family is served from. It is derived from the functional-site gate class observation, never hand-written: the deriver keeps the subset that falls inside the byte-heavy trees the profile otherwise defers, which is the part a reduced checkout can be missing.
functional_corpus.builder_role: Reads the procurement, land, rules, property, staffing and meeting read models and writes the Browse and Now documents the served site routes resolve to.

vintage_anchor.why: The day the functional harness pins its browser clock to, read by test/functional/assets/fixture_clock.py from this snapshot's own vintage. The readiness receipt reports the same anchor so a corpus and the clock it implies are one fact rather than two.

functional_corpus.coverage_note: The corpus is a precondition of the preparation step, so every functional test served from the prepared _site depends on it. Only the tests named in measured_functional_tests were run end to end in a provisioned reduced checkout, so only those are claimed as measured coverage.
functional_corpus.remediation: node tools/verify_functional_corpus.mjs --check names the paths this checkout is missing and the exact tools/provision_card_profile.sh hydrate command that materialises them.
